targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 + COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS balance FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS pnl FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (c.close - t.entry_price) ELSE (t.entry_price - c.close) END)/t.entry_price * t.notional_usdt),0) AS unrealized FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM trades
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0*SUM((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int)/COUNT(*) END AS win_rate FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS today FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

SELECT q.t AS "time", q.equity FROM (SELECT exit_ts, to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS t, 100 + SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS equity FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) q WHERE q.t BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY q.exit_ts

SELECT to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS "time", bot_id AS metric, SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (PARTITION BY bot_id ORDER BY exit_ts) AS cumulative_pnl FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY exit_ts

SELECT q.t AS "time", q.equity - GREATEST(MAX(q.equity) OVER (ORDER BY q.exit_ts), 100) AS drawdown FROM (SELECT exit_ts, to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS t, 100 + SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS equity FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) q WHERE q.t BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY q.exit_ts

SELECT MIN(equity - GREATEST(peak, 100)) AS max_dd FROM (SELECT equity, MAX(equity) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS peak FROM (SELECT exit_ts, to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS t, 100 + SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS equity FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) a) b

SELECT (SELECT 100 + COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) - GREATEST((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(equity),100) FROM (SELECT exit_ts, to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS t, 100 + SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS equity FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) z), 100) AS current_dd
SELECT to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS "time", pnl_net_usdt AS net_pnl FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY exit_ts

SELECT q.t AS "time", q.notional_exposure AS "notional_$", q.margin_used AS "margin_$" FROM (SELECT ts, to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS t, SUM(nd) OVER (ORDER BY ts, ord) AS notional_exposure, SUM(md) OVER (ORDER BY ts, ord) AS margin_used FROM (SELECT entry_ts AS ts, notional_usdt AS nd, size_usdt AS md, 0 AS ord FROM trades UNION ALL SELECT exit_ts AS ts, -notional_usdt AS nd, -size_usdt AS md, 1 AS ord FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) e) q WHERE q.t BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY q.ts

panels.title: Exposure Over Time — open notional & margin deployed

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(bot_id,'-',4) AS strategy, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) AS closed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NULL) AS open, ROUND(100.0*SUM((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL)/NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),0),1) AS win_rate, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),4) AS avg_pnl, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),4) AS net_pnl FROM trades GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY net_pnl DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: 🏆 Strategy Leaderboard — head-to-head by net PnL (bake-off)

targets.rawSql: SELECT q.t AS "time", q.r20 AS "rolling_20", q.cum AS "cumulative" FROM (SELECT exit_ts, to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS t, 100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS r20, 100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS cum FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) q WHERE q.t BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY q.exit_ts

panels.title: Rolling Win-Rate — last 20 trades vs cumulative (55% = go-live target)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Wins' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'Losses', COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt<=0
SELECT close_reason AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY close_reason ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE pnl_net_usdt>0),4) AS avg_win, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE pnl_net_usdt<=0),4) AS avg_loss, ROUND(MAX(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS largest_win, ROUND(MIN(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS largest_loss, ROUND(AVG(hold_candles),1) AS avg_hold_candles, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE pnl_net_usdt>0)/NULLIF(-SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE pnl_net_usdt<=0),0),0),2) AS profit_factor FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT pair, COUNT(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*SUM((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int)/NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),0),1) AS win_rate, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),4) AS net_pnl FROM trades GROUP BY pair ORDER BY net_pnl NULLS LAST

SELECT pattern, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) AS closed, ROUND(100.0*SUM((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int)/NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),0),1) AS win_rate, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL),4) AS net_pnl FROM trades GROUP BY pattern ORDER BY net_pnl NULLS LAST

SELECT 'TP '||round((regexp_match(split_part(bot_id,'-',4),'t([0-9]+)'))[1]::numeric/10,1) AS metric, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt),5) AS value FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND split_part(bot_id,'-',4) ~ '^t[0-9]+s[0-9]+h[0-9]+$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY metric

panels.title: Avg net PnL/trade by TP multiple

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'SL '||round((regexp_match(split_part(bot_id,'-',4),'s([0-9]+)'))[1]::numeric/10,1) AS metric, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt),5) AS value FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND split_part(bot_id,'-',4) ~ '^t[0-9]+s[0-9]+h[0-9]+$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY metric

panels.title: Avg net PnL/trade by SL multiple

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'hold '||(regexp_match(split_part(bot_id,'-',4),'h([0-9]+)'))[1] AS metric, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt),5) AS value FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND split_part(bot_id,'-',4) ~ '^t[0-9]+s[0-9]+h[0-9]+$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY metric

SELECT session, COUNT(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*SUM((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int)/COUNT(*),1) AS win_rate, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS net_pnl, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS avg_pnl FROM (SELECT pnl_net_usdt, CASE WHEN h>=13 AND h<16 THEN 'OVERLAP' WHEN h>=8 AND h<16 THEN 'LONDON' WHEN h>=13 AND h<21 THEN 'US' ELSE 'ASIAN' END AS session FROM (SELECT pnl_net_usdt, ((entry_ts/3600000)::bigint % 24) AS h FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) a) b GROUP BY session ORDER BY net_pnl NULLS LAST

SELECT session AS metric, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS value FROM (SELECT pnl_net_usdt, CASE WHEN h>=13 AND h<16 THEN 'OVERLAP' WHEN h>=8 AND h<16 THEN 'LONDON' WHEN h>=13 AND h<21 THEN 'US' ELSE 'ASIAN' END AS session FROM (SELECT pnl_net_usdt, ((entry_ts/3600000)::bigint % 24) AS h FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) a) b GROUP BY session ORDER BY value
SELECT 100.0*AVG((close_reason='take_profit')::int) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT 100.0*AVG((close_reason='stop_loss')::int) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT 100.0*AVG((close_reason='timeout')::int) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT 100.0*AVG((close_reason='liquidated')::int) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG((CASE WHEN direction='long' THEN exit_price-entry_price ELSE entry_price-exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(entry_price-sl_price),0)),3) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS(tp_price-entry_price)/NULLIF(ABS(entry_price-sl_price),0)),2) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.hi - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.lo)/t.entry_price*100 END),3) AS v FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(high) AS hi, MIN(low) AS lo FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts AND t.exit_ts) px ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.lo - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.hi)/t.entry_price*100 END),3) AS v FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(high) AS hi, MIN(low) AS lo FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts AND t.exit_ts) px ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(hold_candles),2) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG((exit_ts-entry_ts)/60000.0),1) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fee_entry_usdt+COALESCE(fee_exit_usdt,0)),4) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS(entry_price-liquidation_price)/entry_price*100),2) AS v FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT bucket AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN r<=-1 THEN '1: ≤ -1R (full stop)' WHEN r<0 THEN '2: -1..0R' WHEN r<1 THEN '3: 0..1R' WHEN r<2 THEN '4: 1..2R' ELSE '5: ≥ 2R' END AS bucket FROM (SELECT (CASE WHEN direction='long' THEN exit_price-entry_price ELSE entry_price-exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(entry_price-sl_price),0) AS r FROM trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL) x WHERE r IS NOT NULL) y GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT t.close_reason, COUNT(*) AS trades, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.hi - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.lo)/t.entry_price*100 END),3) AS avg_mfe_pct, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.lo - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.hi)/t.entry_price*100 END),3) AS avg_mae_pct, ROUND(AVG((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN t.exit_price-t.entry_price ELSE t.entry_price-t.exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(t.entry_price - t.sl_price),0)),2) AS avg_realized_r FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(high) AS hi, MIN(low) AS lo FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts AND t.exit_ts) px ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.close_reason ORDER BY trades DESC

panels.title: Excursion by Close Reason — did winners run / losers get stopped on noise?

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.entry_ts/1000.0) AS entry_time, to_timestamp(t.exit_ts/1000.0) AS exit_time, t.pair, t.direction AS dir, t.leverage AS lev, ROUND(t.entry_price,6) AS entry, ROUND(t.exit_price,6) AS exit, ROUND(t.tp_price,6) AS tp, ROUND(t.sl_price,6) AS sl, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN t.exit_price-t.entry_price ELSE t.entry_price-t.exit_price END,6) AS points, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.exit_price-t.entry_price)/t.entry_price ELSE (t.entry_price-t.exit_price)/t.entry_price END*100,3) AS move_pct, ROUND((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN t.exit_price-t.entry_price ELSE t.entry_price-t.exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(t.entry_price - t.sl_price),0),2) AS r_mult, ROUND(ABS(t.tp_price-t.entry_price)/NULLIF(ABS(t.entry_price - t.sl_price),0),2) AS plan_rr, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.hi - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.lo)/t.entry_price*100 END,3) AS mfe_pct, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.lo - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.hi)/t.entry_price*100 END,3) AS mae_pct, t.hold_candles AS candles, ROUND((t.exit_ts-t.entry_ts)/60000.0,0) AS dur_min, ROUND(t.fee_entry_usdt+COALESCE(t.fee_exit_usdt,0),4) AS fees, ROUND(t.pnl_net_usdt,4) AS net_pnl, ROUND(t.pnl_pct,2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(ABS(t.entry_price-t.liquidation_price)/t.entry_price*100,2) AS liq_dist_pct, ROUND(t.bucket_balance_after,4) AS bal_after, t.close_reason AS reason, t.pattern FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(high) AS hi, MIN(low) AS lo FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts AND t.exit_ts) px ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.exit_ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Trade History (closed) — full detail: TP/SL, R-multiple, MFE/MAE, duration

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.entry_ts/1000.0) AS entry_time, t.pair, t.direction, t.leverage, ROUND(t.entry_price,6) AS entry, ROUND(c.close,6) AS current, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (c.close - t.entry_price) ELSE (t.entry_price - c.close) END,6) AS points, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (c.close - t.entry_price) ELSE (t.entry_price - c.close) END/t.entry_price*100,3) AS move_pct, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (c.close - t.entry_price) ELSE (t.entry_price - c.close) END/t.entry_price*t.notional_usdt,4) AS unrealized_pnl, ROUND(t.tp_price,6) AS tp, ROUND(t.sl_price,6) AS sl, t.size_usdt AS margin, t.notional_usdt AS notional, t.pattern FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NULL ORDER BY t.entry_ts DESC

SELECT split_part(message,':',2) AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM events WHERE category='signal' AND message LIKE 'signal_rejected:%' AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000 GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS time, bot_id, level, category, message FROM events ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT bot_id, status, pid, to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS last_heartbeat, CASE WHEN ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 90000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alive FROM heartbeats ORDER BY bot_id
SELECT COALESCE(((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - MAX(ts))/1000.0, 9999) AS age FROM heartbeats
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM candles WHERE to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bot_id) AS bots FROM heartbeats WHERE ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 90000
